split_policy: Fixed training and held-out selectors/traffic kinds/operations before token scoring; held-out does not select the candidate.
instructions: Preserve all selected fields, false/null distinctions, fetched_at, unknown source age, gaps and errors. Inventory is dated evidence, rates are not throughput or egress proof. Requests and inverse previews grant no authority. Every apply, including inverse/no-op, requires a separate administrator exact-plan grant within the 300-second plan lifetime and a human personally typing apply HASH over verified HTTPS. Agents never install grants or type confirmations. Firewall restart and all-client blocking are distinct effects. Verify uncertainty without repeating writes.
decoder: Decode each single JSON stdout; retain stderr and exit code. Follow next_offset until null. Reassemble ordered rows with unchanged non-pagination metadata; pagination is traversal evidence, not omitted selected data.
